text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks the start of Narita Taishin's journey to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To show off her amazing final sprint, and to get the better of all those who underestimate her…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We must first work together towards her debut.
